additional_blocking_findings.title: Finished command output is rebound to a replacement lease

observed.name: log-must-stay-bound-to-generating-lease
observed.method: Real H04/H06 container command reads a harmless temporary marker under original permission; replace lease after real wait completes, before Registry archive
observed.expected: Reject returning or archiving old-scope output after replacement; never relabel it with the replacement lease

additional_blocking_findings.expected: Log provenance must retain the authority that generated the output; a replacement that protects the original source cannot retroactively authorize or relabel that output.
additional_blocking_findings.cause: The Registry finishes and reads the old command, then archive() samples the current lease. A replacement after wait returns is not associated with the generating lease, so old-scope bytes are marked with the new lease hash and pass later page checks.
additional_blocking_findings.reproduction_scope: Actual H04/H06 container and real wait/read_log/archive/page. Only wait return scheduling is wrapped to replace authority deterministically. The private marker is a harmless temporary fixture, not a real secret.
repair_request: Capture the generating lease identity/provenance before launching the command and carry it through log collection and CAS registration.
Reject old-scope output when authority was replaced or revoked before response/archive; do not resample and relabel it as current authority.
Add boundary regressions for finished wait/poll/read_log/return/archive, including a replacement that adds a protected path while retaining a root read path.
Recheck the newly frozen implementation; this review does not modify production source or start H11.
